panels.title: Petrify
panels.text: Skips its next turn and gains 5 Block.

panels.title: Detonate
panels.text: When destroyed, the keg deals 6 to everything on and next to it.

panels.title: Cinder Marks
panels.text: At your next turn, the marked tiles take the damage, you included, and turn to Fire.

panels.title: Raise Terrain
panels.text: Raises a Worldspine with this much Health on each empty tile around the target.

panels.title: Raise Terrain
panels.text: Raises an outcrop with this much Health that blocks movement and sight.

panels.title: Raise Terrain
panels.text: Places a powder keg with this much Health that blocks movement, not sight.

panels.title: Ice
panels.text: The chosen Ice and all Ice connected to it become Electrified.

panels.title: Light
panels.text: Only enemies standing in Light are hit.

panels.title: Fire
panels.text: Only enemies standing on Fire are hit.

panels.title: Chilled
panels.text: Only Chilled enemies are hit.

panels.title: Electrified
panels.text: Only enemies standing on Electrified ground are hit.

panels.title: Shatter
panels.text: If the target was Frozen, deal 5 to each enemy next to it.

panels.title: Terrain Burst
panels.text: Each turn, enemies next to your Worldspines take 3.

panels.title: Terrain Burst
panels.text: Destroy an outcrop, crate or other terrain in range and sight.

panels.title: Terrain Burst
panels.text: Destroy an adjacent outcrop or Worldspine you raised.

panels.title: If at Half Health
panels.text: This bonus applies if the target is at or below half Health.

panels.title: If Frozen
panels.text: This bonus applies if the target is Frozen.

panels.title: If in Light
panels.text: This bonus applies if the target stands in Light.

panels.title: Block
panels.text: Your illusion takes all your Block as extra Health.

panels.title: Retaliate
panels.text: Enemies that damage this illusion take 4 Lightning damage and are Shocked.

panels.title: Retaliate
panels.text: Enemies that damage this illusion take that much damage too.

panels.title: Retaliate
panels.text: Until your next turn, enemies that hit you in melee take 3.

panels.title: Move
panels.text: Deals 1 more for each tile you moved this turn, up to 5 more.

panels.title: Next Attack
panels.text: Your next attack this turn deals 1 more per tile you moved, up to 4 more.

panels.title: Stoneskin
panels.text: Deals 1 more for each Stoneskin you have, up to 6 more.

panels.title: Next Attack
panels.text: Your next attack this turn deals 4 more and Pierces.

panels.title: Next Attack
panels.text: Your next Lightning attack this turn gains Chain 2.

panels.title: Block
panels.text: Turn all your Block into Stoneskin.

panels.title: Quicken
panels.text: Your next card this turn costs 1 less Time.

panels.title: Shock
panels.text: Every enemy this hits is Shocked.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Choose an Ice tile within this range and line of sight.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Place the Light within this range.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Place the illusion within this range.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Place the outcrop within this range.

panels.title: Expend
panels.text: Removes the Ice on each pattern tile.

panels.title: Light
panels.text: Creates Light of this radius on each tile you enter.

panels.title: Light
panels.text: Creates Light of this radius at the target.

panels.title: Light
panels.text: Creates Light of this radius where you land.

panels.title: Cleanse
panels.text: Remove Bleed, Immobilize and Chilled from yourself.

panels.title: Light
panels.text: Creates Light of this radius.

panels.title: Push
panels.text: Pushes each enemy within 3 of you 3 tiles away.

panels.title: Pull
panels.text: Pulls each enemy within 3 of the chosen tile 3 tiles toward it.

panels.title: Push
panels.text: Push the target 2 tiles in any open direction.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Destroy terrain within this range.

panels.title: Range
panels.text: Destroy an illusion within this range.

panels.title: Area Attack
panels.text: Hits the red tiles, aimed at the adjacent tile you choose.
